name: Water Blaster — Shark 43 cm
description: An electric continuous-spray water blaster with one-key water intake. 43 cm long and 18 cm high. The box has the blaster, a rechargeable battery and a USB charging cable. Water only. Don't aim at faces or animals. Adult supervision for young children.

source.notes: Style code 927 (photo text: one-key absorption, electric burst water gun, 43 cm x 18 cm). Matched to the style-list thumbnails. Capacity not shown. Printed "WATER GUN" and a shark logo on the body. Same 1688 offer (1089431913643) as the rest of the water-blaster range. MOQ unclear: the page says "1 Box starting batch" and lists carton counts of 12-48 pcs, so whether the price is per piece for a 1-piece order or needs a carton is unconfirmed. Prices are per piece from the style list. Store return rate not shown in the screenshots. China freight ¥4/order (note only, not costed). Lithium battery: sea freight only. Realistic firearm-shaped toy: possible customs hold as an imitation firearm, owner to confirm with the clearing agent. Range is stated only on the 2309 box photo (8-10 m, seller figure) and used there; none is claimed for other models. No safety certification shown or claimed. Supplier photos are 800 px (soft once enlarged).
